inputs.prompt: Run the complete single-sample WASP, GATK ASEReadCounter, and phase-oriented peak workflow on bounded public NA12878 ATAC/genotype data; inspect sample identity, BAM invariants, allele-count rows, and the peak table.
Aggregate phased allele counts with opposite REF encodings, multiple phase blocks, empty and malformed inputs, paths with spaces, and two disjoint BED4 peaks that share a display name.
Challenge target-sample selection, BAM/VCF mismatch, missing phase-set data, staged-failure cleanup, quoted paths, and output-reuse refusal.

Execute two public RASQUAL feature rows, validate matrix and VCF dimensions, inspect finite p-values, independently recompute BH across the complete family, and test zero-feature and reuse boundaries.
Audit exact candidate and provider identity, canonical provenance, external-only MatrixEQTL and QuASAR routing, and the scope of phasing, multiplicity, power, and concordance claims.
